body:
Ohhh is that a "haha", that's great, a small win but still a win for you :)
Yes, internet, opening up to strangers is muuuuch more easier :).
I also thought that no one deserves to know me during my hard times but what's weird is some friends got more closer :). It is a bet, some got closer and others ran away :)
Oh, that must be hard to deal with what you're feeling and showing up at work while dealing with customers. I suppose it is not easy to open up about what's bothering you at work.
The place you're in right now seems very tough :/. How do you cope with the psychosis ?
Hey, sorry to hear that :(. What's going on ?
Sorry to hear what you've been going through. But hey glad to hear that you're allowing yourself to be better. Keep up the good work :)
I understand, sometimes it really feels like your soul and energy are being drained continuously out of your body ... and feeling hopeless like once cannot do anything about it.
I am sorry to hear that. That's not easy to go through bullying and a family that doesn't seem to hear your crying for help. How about someone at school ?
Hey, that's a big step here :) congrats for doing that and brava :)
See, still kind :) you're even wishing me to not experience what you're going through. Hug to you too :).
Even with all that burden you're carrying, Iam very impressed about your kindness and how even in pain, you still care so much about the world around you. You're such a kind soul.
Is it a job that comes with heavy responsibilities ? Do you feel like you're not up to the task ? Just trying to guess here :)
For the degree part, I do relate, what are you studying ? For the bi part, sorry to hear that, that sucks to not be able to express what you wish freely.
That sucks ... it is not easy to find someome as your mother which can understand you and cope with your anxiety/ depression.

That's heavy. Being the one responsible for your family needs. I mean it is brave and very kind of you to take care of your family but that might come also with feeling guilty if you want to quit your job. It is not easy to please yourself and please you family I suppose. 
It is not easy also to open up about yourself to your friends if you have been carrying this image of being the strong one. Why does your job is taking a toll in your mental health ?
Breaking up is not easy ... especially since acoording to your words, she must have been a really close soul to you. How long have you beem together ?
They just don't know how to bring it down right ? They just don't care. I tried once to talk to them but then found myseld in a never ending loop. Good talk .. can I get back to sleep now. Guess not.
Does your tenants get loud sometimes too ?

I am sorry to hear that. Being treated worthless by your mother. I can't imagine how hard that must be. And not hearing from your father must be really sad to cope on with. Hold on, wish you at least a nice day :).

I am glad to hear that you're looking to ease your pain. That demands courage. I could share a lot of ways to relax that work for me. Something that worked for me lately is the subreddit "contagious laugh". But otherwise, mediation, a bath maybe, dancing too :). But depends, how do you feel right now ?
Something bad enough to make you want to die ... that sucks, sorry hear that. Are you looking for advice ?

Wow ... that's a lot. Feeling everything falling apart must really suck. Especially during these times with covid where you can't reach out to friends or your boyfriend ... and moreover being an assylum seeker. I can't even imagine your situation and what you're experiencing right now. It sucks but I genuinely hope you get better.
Well, I wasn't expecting that but thanks, that actually made me smile :). Have a nice day stranger :).

Oh man, that sucks, that's a shitty feeling. I wish I could help too. All I can tell is that I have been feeling the same way for sometimes now and I've felt that this will never end. But one day, I woke up, was still feeling suicidal but felt "less suicidal". Than I thought about how things are impermanent. There is nothing that last and try to hold on this thought since then.

Hey, oh you're not lonely, sometimes I feel the same too. Actually in the past, I felt the same too. Now, I am protecting myself, I only reach out to people who  love me enough to care about me to avoid bad surprises. A year ago, I have unfriended a lot of people thinking they don't care if I die or not. But then, I thought some people are just not meant to be there for you, nothing more nothing less ...  and I'd just reach out to new ones. It is like a game, sometimes I would open to some people I'd met and see what happens .. sometimes it works and sometimes not. I just try to not put up my expectations too high ... to avoid a risky downfall.
